opening.argument: The speaker walks through an alleged free Litecoin-earning platform, explaining registration, ways to earn, referral commissions, and withdrawal settings. That is an educational demonstration of how the platform is presented, not proof that its earnings claims work. The speaker directs viewers to a link and describes earning through platform activities, but the description explicitly says earnings are not guaranteed. The withdrawal discussion is conditional on continued activity; the supplied material does not show a completed withdrawal or paid referral commission. The claims remain claims, while the observable presentation is a walkthrough of the platform’s features and conditions.
